high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a webpage from Wikipedia, specifically the article about Herbert Hoover, the 31st President of the United States. The page includes a photograph of Herbert Hoover, labeled "Hoover in 1928," which shows him in formal attire, wearing a suit and tie, with a serious expression on his face. The background is dark, emphasizing the subject. The text above the photograph provides context about Hoover's presidency. It mentions that he was elected president in 1928 and that his presidency was dominated by the Great Depression.
